title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Goodwill Waiver Authority, Annual Allowance and Request Window
content:
The desk's goodwill latitude on Dangerous Goods Acceptance fees is bounded by three category figures: the largest single fee entry it may waive, how many goodwill waivers one customer may receive within a rolling 365 days, and how many calendar days after a fee was booked a waiver may still be asked for.

| Category | Largest fee entry the desk may waive (USD) | Goodwill waivers per customer per trailing 365 days | Request window after the fee was booked (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0.00 | 0 | 30 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 100.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 150.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 200.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 200.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 0.00 | 0 | 15 |

## Remarks

- Where the allowance is 0, the category offers the desk no goodwill waiver at all, and the authority column shows 0.00 accordingly.
- The authority figure is compared with a single fee entry, not with the total the customer owes.
